title: Compact control: ARIA language harmonization and contrast matrix for dense table & chart widgets
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Audit and remediate ARIA copy/role inconsistencies and color-token contrast shortfalls for compact/dense components (mini buttons, inline filters, ledger tables, and sparkline charts). Deliver a contrast matrix tied to color token names, a canonical ARIA role/label table for compact controls, and a VPAT evidence pack with test artifacts and keyboard scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: Contrast matrix maps every compact token variant to a WCAG 2.1 AA ratio (>=4.5:1 for normal text; 3:1 for large text) or documents the trade-off and compensating controls.
Canonical ARIA mapping (role + aria-label/aria-labelledby guidance) published for: compact table rows, inline action pills, chart legends, mini-dropdowns, and cell action menus.
Keyboard nav flows documented with deterministic focus order, skip targets for dense lists, and regression suite (Playwright + VoiceOver keyboard trace) added to the design QA repo.
VPAT evidence bundle created with sample pages, test logs, and reviewer notes suitable for sharing with compliance teams.
Design tokens updated where contrast fixes required; changes scoped to compact-density tokens with fallback tokens documented to avoid platform-wide regressions.
tasks: Run automated color-contrast scan across compact token set (tools: pa11y/axe-cypress).
Manual review of rendered components at 12px and 14px sizes for text/button labels and chart axis annotations.
Draft ARIA mapping doc and circulate for Eng/PM review (include examples and failure modes).
Prototype keyboard-only interaction flows for compact table and chart widgets; capture screen recording and clip of VoiceOver narration.
Create VPAT evidence directory and copy of sample pages that exercise required scenarios.
Raise PR to tokens repo to add high-contrast fallback tokens and update token usage guidance in the design token README.
design_notes: We found multiple places where semantic roles were inconsistently applied between compact and regular components (eg. compact table row controls used button + role=menuitem in some places). Decision: standardize on explicit role mapping and avoid implicit role assumptions. For contrast, prefer a token-layer fix scoped to compact density (e.g., --color-text-compact, --color-action-compact) to limit cascade risk. Where token changes cause visual regressions in enterprise dashboards, provide an opt-in CSS utility class (.compact-a11y) to enable patched values until downstream teams can migrate.
testing_plan: Automated runs: axe + color-contrast check on CI for compact storybook stories.
Manual: keyboard-only walkthrough checklist with video capture for 8 scenarios (compact table sorting, row actions, inline filter chips, chart legend toggle).
Screen reader tests: VoiceOver (mac), NVDA (Windows) on the same scenarios, include timing notes for focus announcements.
